orgDesign.companyProfile: Enterprise software platform serving revenue leaders, sellers, service operators, and admins through CRM, monetization, service, data, automation, and AI workflows.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Revenue teams own pipeline and monetization loops. Service teams own assisted and digital service operations. Platform teams own data, identity, automation, AI, and integration foundations shared across every customer workflow.
designPrinciples: Keep account and opportunity workflows close to manager inspection because customers judge them as one operating loop.
Keep configuration, pricing, quote, and billing logic tightly connected because revenue friction appears at the handoff boundaries.
Keep self-service, knowledge, and AI guidance together because digital containment only works when those layers reinforce each other.
Keep trusted data, identity, and automation governance together because AI adoption depends on the combined trust posture.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for revenue acquisition, monetization, service operations, and platform foundations.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
